assessments.reasoning: SAP's Help Portal served the exact frozen bytes. The release notice identifies AS ABAP Release 754 and SAP SE. The first paragraph of ABAP - Keyword Documentation identifies ABAP as the language whose keywords are described and assigns ABAP Objects to its object-oriented part. That wording directly supports the scoped descriptive identity. The paragraph's ensuing reference to frameworks and system classes concerns the documentation's additional coverage.

challenge.method: Read the heading, edition notice, opening paragraph and topic list to test whether ABAP Objects was presented as a peer language and whether the name ABAP referred to the product as a whole.
challenge.results: The opening assigns ABAP Objects to the ABAP language as a part. The release label and separate references to related systems and frameworks confirm the language reading.

limitations: This is the AS ABAP 7.54 documentation boundary. Runtime behavior, development tooling, cloud restrictions, and present-day product support are outside the cited relationship.
